description: B2B Activities + Follow-up system + Partnership Pipeline board. Builds the activity screens (My Tasks, Follow-ups, Calls, Meetings, Activity History), the follow-up workflow (today/upcoming/overdue with inline update from the list), and the drag-and-drop Partnership Pipeline modeled on the existing pipeline.tsx. Depends on FEAT-002 (b2b_activities, b2b_followups, partnerships) and FEAT-003 (firm/lead screens).
steps: Activities routes under src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/activities/: index.tsx 'My Tasks' (tasks + followups assigned to the current user, admin sees all), calls.tsx (b2b_activities type='call'), meetings.tsx (type='meeting'), history.tsx 'Activity History' (full chronological feed, filterable by firm/lead/type/date). Reuse the activity logging/display pattern from leads/$id.tsx and the Calls section pattern. Each activity row links to its firm/lead/contact.

Follow-ups route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/activities/followups.tsx (and surface the same data on the dashboard in FEAT-006): three buckets — Today's Follow-ups, Upcoming, Overdue — computed from b2b_followups.due_at vs now. Support inline update directly from the list (mark done, set next follow-up date + remark) WITHOUT opening the firm page, mirroring spec section 10. Each update: set status, stamp completed_at, increment b2b_leads.follow_up_count, update last_contacted_at/next_follow_up_at/latest_remark on the related lead/firm, write a b2b_activities followup row, and logAudit. Put the bucketing (today/upcoming/overdue) in a pure helper in src/lib/b2b-followups.ts with tests in b2b-followups.test.ts.

Partnership Pipeline route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/pipeline.tsx — a drag-and-drop board over the 10 B2B_PIPELINE_STAGES (New Prospect -> Active Partner) from src/lib/b2b.ts, with lost/closed outcomes handled separately (a column or a move-to-closed action requiring a reason, like the Sales pipeline's Lost/Not-Interested reason dialog). Model directly on src/routes/_authenticated/pipeline.tsx (same @dnd-kit usage, card layout, optimistic stage update + rollback). Moving a card updates partnerships.stage (and ca_firms.partner_status where appropriate) and logs an activity + audit entry. Admin sees all; b2b users see their assigned firms/partnerships (RLS enforces).
Add 'Pipeline' plus the Activities subgroup (My Tasks, Follow-ups, Calls, Meetings, Activity History) to the B2B sidebar section. guardRoles(['admin','b2b']) on all new routes.

Follow the performance rule: do NOT export the pipeline board component from the route file (TanStack code-splitter leaves it unsplit) — if the board is heavy, put it in src/components/b2b/partnership-pipeline.tsx and lazy-load, matching how renewal-dashboard.tsx was extracted.
Rebuild to regenerate routeTree.gen.ts and commit. Prettier new files; no new eslint errors on touched files.
acceptance_criteria: Activity screens (My Tasks, Calls, Meetings, Activity History) render B2B activities with a chronological timeline and link back to firm/lead/contact.

Follow-ups page shows Today/Upcoming/Overdue buckets and allows marking done + setting the next follow-up with a remark inline from the list, updating the lead's follow-up fields and writing an activity + audit row.
A drag-and-drop Partnership Pipeline over the 10 stages works like the Sales pipeline, with separate lost/closed handling requiring a reason, updating partnerships/firm status.
Bucketing logic is pure and tested in b2b-followups.test.ts.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` green, `bun run build` succeeds; no component is exported from a route file into the entry chunk.
verification: Confirm the pipeline board is defined in a component file (not exported from the route) so it stays out of the entry chunk.
findings: Gate green: npx tsc --noEmit clean; bun run test = 190 passed / 14 files (179 after FEAT-004 + 11 new b2b-followups tests); bun run build ok (~12s) and regenerated src/routeTree.gen.ts with all 6 new routes (/b2b/pipeline, /b2b/activities/, /b2b/activities/followups, /b2b/activities/calls, /b2b/activities/meetings, /b2b/activities/history). Delivered: (1) src/lib/b2b-followups.ts — PURE, DB-free bucketing: istDayKey() (IST +05:30 civil-date key, host-timezone independent), bucketFor(dueAt, now) -> overdue|today|upcoming by COMPARING IST DAY KEYS (not raw timestamps, so a follow-up earlier today still counts Today not Overdue), bucketFollowups(list, now) preserving input order; now is always passed in for determinism. (2) src/lib/b2b-followups.test.ts — 11 tests covering the UTC->IST day roll-over at 18:30 UTC (= IST midnight), the exact today/upcoming/overdue boundaries (earlier-today, later-today, yesterday, tomorrow, the IST-midnight edge), order preservation and the empty case; would fail if bucketing were reverted. (3) src/components/b2b/partnership-pipeline.tsx — the dnd-kit board (PartnershipPipelineBoard), COPIED from src/routes/_authenticated/pipeline.tsx: DndContext + useDraggable/useDroppable, column/card layout, OPTIMISTIC stage update via onMutate with snapshot ROLLBACK on error (onError restores + onSettled invalidates), and the Sales-style MANDATORY-reason dialog. 10 forward columns from B2B_PIPELINE_STAGES + an extra dashed 'Lost / Closed' droppable column (sentinel id '__closed__'); dropping a card there opens the reason dialog and sets partnerships.status='lost' + outcome_reason + closed_at and ca_firms.partner_status='lost'. Forward moves to partner_onboarded/first_referral/active_partner also bump ca_firms.partner_status (active/strategic via STAGE_TO_FIRM_STATUS). Every move writes a b2b_activities note + logAudit('stage_change','ca_firm'). (4) src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/pipeline.tsx — THIN route rendering <PartnershipPipelineBoard/>; the board is NOT exported from the route file so TanStack code-splits it — VERIFIED: the board's 'b2b-partnerships-board' query key appears ONLY in dist/server/assets/pipeline-*.js (0 occurrences in the _authenticated/entry chunk; the only 'Partnership Pipeline' string in _authenticated is the nav label). (5) src/components/b2b/activity-feed.tsx — shared chronological feed (type icons, subject/outcome/notes, links to firm, names lead) used by Calls (type='call'), Meetings (type='meeting') and Activity History (type filter + from/to date range + search). (6) Activities routes under src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/activities/: index.tsx 'My Tasks' (pending follow-ups bucketed today/upcoming/overdue + type='task' activities; admin sees all, b2b users see assignedTo/createdBy themselves), followups.tsx (3 buckets via the pure helper; inline CompleteFollowupDialog marks done + sets next date + remark WITHOUT opening the firm, via completeFollowup()), calls.tsx, meetings.tsx, history.tsx — all thin, all guardRoles(['admin','b2b']). (7) src/lib/b2b-queries.ts extended ADDITIVELY: listActivityFeed(filters) + ActivityWithRefs (joins ca_firms(firm_name)+b2b_leads(contact_person)); listFollowupsWithRefs + FollowupWithRefs; createFollowup/NewFollowup; completeFollowup() orchestrating the spec-section-10 workflow (mark done+completed_at+remark; bump b2b_leads.follow_up_count; refresh last_contacted_at/next_follow_up_at/latest_remark; touch ca_firms.updated_at; write a type='followup' b2b_activities row; create the next pending follow-up if a date is given); listPartnershipsWithFirm + PartnershipWithFirm; createPartnership/NewPartnership; updatePartnershipStage() (forward stage move or lost/won close with reason+closed_at, optional ca_firms.partner_status). (8) app-shell.tsx: appended 6 FLAT NAV items (My Tasks, Follow-ups, B2B Calls, Meetings, Activity History, Partnership Pipeline) after Import History, gated ['admin','b2b']; MobileTabBar derives from the same array. GOTCHAS/decisions: (a) completeFollowup/updatePartnershipStage/setPrimaryContact are sequential small writes (no RPC available) — safe because RLS scopes rows to the owner; logAudit is left to the UI caller (fire-and-forget, needs the actor). (b) The activities/ folder has an index.tsx + sibling leaf files (calls/meetings/history/followups) and NO activities.tsx, so they are all independent leaf routes — no Outlet needed (unlike the import/ nesting gotcha from FEAT-004). (c) app-shell carries pre-existing prettier wrapping deviations on several long single-line NAV entries (the repo keeps them on one line); my 6 added items were pre-wrapped to EXACTLY match `prettier` output (My Tasks/Follow-ups/B2B Calls/Pipeline fit on one line; Meetings/Activity History wrap to multi-line objects) so NO new prettier deviation was introduced — do NOT run prettier --write on app-shell.tsx. (d) all new .ts/.tsx are prettier-clean and eslint 0-problems. (e) IST bucketing matches the HRMS +05:30 convention and is host-timezone independent (shift epoch then read UTC parts). (f) 'now' flows in from the page as Date.now() so the pure helper stays testable.
